name: read_file
description: Read the contents of a file in the active project. Returns the file as plain text. Path must be inside the project root. Files in node_modules / .git / .env / .ssh are blocked. Max 1MB per read.

path.description: Path to the file. Can be relative to the project root (e.g. "src/auth.js") or absolute (must still be inside the project root).

name: list_files
description: List files and subdirectories in a directory of the active project. Returns up to 200 entries. Use this to discover what files exist before reading them.

path.description: Directory path, relative to the project root or absolute (must be inside the project root). Use "." or "" for the project root itself.

name: grep_code
description: Search the active project for a text pattern. Returns up to 50 matching lines with file:line prefixes. Use this to find references to a symbol, function, or string across the codebase. Skips node_modules and .git automatically.

query.description: Text to search for (plain text, not regex by default).

fileGlob.description: Optional file pattern to restrict the search (e.g. "*.js", "**/*.tsx"). Omit to search all files.

name: edit_file
description: Edit an existing file by exact-match string replacement. Reject if old_string is not unique unless replace_all=true. Reject if path is outside the project root or hits the blocklist. The user must Approve the diff in a modal before this runs.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to project root (e.g. "src/auth.js") or absolute (must stay inside the project root).

old_string.description: Exact text to find (whitespace + casing included).

replace_all.description: When true, replace every occurrence; when false/omitted, old_string MUST be unique in the file.

name: create_file
description: Create a new file in the active project. Errors if the file already exists (use edit_file instead). Max 1MB of content. The user must Approve the preview in a modal before this runs.

path.description: Path for the new file, relative to project root.

content.description: Full contents of the new file.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file from the active project. Errors on directories, missing files, and blocklisted paths. The user must Approve in a modal showing the current contents before this runs.

path.description: Path to the file to delete, relative to project root.
